events.event_hazard: civil crisis and armed conflict in Libya (2011)
key_impacts: Orthopaedic and trauma services were needed and supported at Nalut Hospital during the height of the conflict.
An emergency response programme was mounted in the Nafusa Mountains following the civil crisis that began in February 2011.
As the conflict evolved and the NTC assumed control over most of the country in late August 2011, access expanded to previously inaccessible areas in the Nafusa Mountains.
Hospitals and health facilities required essential drugs, medical supplies, staffing and capacity-building support (including Nalut Hospital and 15+ facilities).
